priorityList: Pre-cast Living Flame so that it lands on pull
Cast Disintegrate until you run out of Essence
Cast Deep Breath a second time
Cast Disintegrate whenever you are near the Essence cap to ensure that you do not waste any resources
Use Fire Breath empower level 1 on cooldown in order to maintain the damage over time effect
Cast Fire Breath and Eternity Surge when they are on cooldown, making sure to leave a 4-5 second window between each Empower cast
Use Deep Breath on cooldown, followed by its additional charge from Strafing Run 7-8 seconds later
Use Hover to maintain uptime whenever you are forced to move
Use Living Flame as a filler
Use Azure Strike as a filler when moving if you have no Hover
